hooks.command: if command -v fwdctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then m='forward-skills: for a network question run: fwdctl which "<question>" (or read plan-investigation); for any change in Forward read plan-safe-write first (plan, show, approval, apply once).'; echo "$m"; else echo 'forward-skills: the fwdctl binary is not on PATH, so these skills cannot run. Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forwardnetworks/forward-skills/main/scripts/install.sh | sh'; fi
